Senses.Explanation: An awakening said to occur all at once rather than by gradual stages. Huineng says that one's own nature awakens of itself, with sudden awakening and sudden refining and no gradual stages (自性自悟，頓悟頓修，亦無漸次). Jianfu Hongbian explains Southern sudden and Northern gradual (南頓北漸) as a difference in how people are led to awaken, not original geographical names within Chan (開導發悟有頓漸之異……非禪宗本有南北之號也). Encounter narratives use the formula awakened suddenly at the words (言下頓悟), as in Bao'en Xuance's fire-boy case. Guxue Zhe pairs the term with gradual removal: principle must be awakened to suddenly, while affairs are removed gradually (理須頓悟……事在漸除). Yongming Yanshou records a fourfold matrix crossing sudden and gradual awakening with sudden and gradual refining (漸修頓悟／頓悟漸修／漸修漸悟／頓悟頓修). Guifeng Zongmi's succession chart defines its own use by saying that awakening from delusion is sudden and turning from ordinary person to sage is sudden awakening (從迷而悟即頓，轉凡成聖即頓悟也). The phrase also enters Dazhu Huihai's work title Treatise on the Essential Gate of Entering the Way through Sudden Awakening (頓悟入道要門論), while Yulin Tongxiu asks an addressee to examine whether he has the capacity for sudden awakening and sudden refining (更須自己覺察是頓悟頓修根器否). Zen bends the ordinary sudden/gradual contrast into an explicit subject of lineage classification, encounter narration, named treatises, and public testing, without making sudden awakening and sudden refining the same event.
Senses.Note: The allowlist has 902 hits in 186 texts; the formula awakened suddenly at the words (言下頓悟) occurs 65 times, sudden awakening and gradual refining (頓悟漸修) 15 times, and sudden awakening and sudden refining (頓悟頓修) 13 times. Seven exact headword witnesses plus one family witness cover definition, encounter, contrast, title, classification, and direct admonition. All uses still denote awakening occurring suddenly; a work title containing the term does not create a second lexical referent.

Occurrences.Kwic: 自性自悟，頓悟頓修，亦無漸次，所以不立一切
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Platform Sutra (六祖大師法寶壇經), Huineng says that self-nature awakens of itself through sudden awakening and sudden refining, without gradual stages.

Occurrences.Kwic: 其所得法雖一。而開導發悟有頓漸之異。故曰南頓北漸。非禪宗本有南北之號也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄), Jianfu Hongbian explains that Southern sudden and Northern gradual (南頓北漸) names a difference in leading people to awaken, not an original north-south division in Chan; this is a family witness because the full headword is absent.

Occurrences.Kwic: 曰丙丁童子來求火師於言下頓悟
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Linked Pearl Collection of Chan Eulogies on Ancient Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集), Bao'en Xuance awakens suddenly at the words in the fire-boy-seeking-fire exchange.

Occurrences.Kwic: 理須頓悟，乘悟并銷，白雲斷處見明月；事在漸除，因次第盡，黃葉落時聞擣衣。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Guxue Zhe (古雪哲禪師語錄), Guxue Zhe says that principle must be awakened to suddenly while affairs are removed gradually.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一漸修頓悟。二頓悟漸修。三漸修漸悟。四頓悟頓修。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Record of the Source-Mirror (宗鏡錄), Yongming Yanshou presents four propositions crossing sudden and gradual awakening with sudden and gradual refining.

Occurrences.Kwic: 從迷而悟即頓，轉凡成聖即頓悟也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Chart of the Master-Disciple Succession of the Chan Gate (中華傳心地禪門師資承襲圖), Guifeng Zongmi defines the text's use of sudden and sudden awakening.

Occurrences.Kwic: 自撰頓悟入道要門論一卷。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Transmission of the Lamp (景德傳燈錄) biography of Dazhu Huihai records his authorship of the Treatise on the Essential Gate of Entering the Way through Sudden Awakening (頓悟入道要門論).

Occurrences.Kwic: 更須自己覺察是頓悟頓修根器否
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of National Master Yulin (普濟玉琳國師語錄), Yulin Tongxiu asks the addressee to examine whether he has the capacity for sudden awakening and sudden refining.
